about: What each class of item is and does in the game, keyed by the Archive's own class id; petest's Annotations/5.4/class-ids.json links each to the VU 5.4 client's class number. Every field READ from the 5.4 client by petest's tools except where said. tabs: the inventory window's category pages the class is filed under, 9 Weapons, 10 Armor, 11 Clothes, 12 Tools, 13 Food, 14 Meds, 15 Material+Money, 16 Docs (ItemBelongsOnPage). stackable: the class descends from the stackable base, whose GetAmount is the count the icon prints, so an item is an amount rather than one object. icon: how the client gets the icon: kind render (drawn from the model at runtime), table (one stored texture per texture variant, which the server held per item) or constant (one stored texture); width and height the icon's size in pixels, 0 where the class declares none; textures the stored texture ids. condition_bar: whether its inventory row shows a condition bar. The Item Info window's choices by class: value_line (value, market for Market Value, balance for the account balance), condition_meter (whether it shows the Condition meter) and stats (the Stats pane's sections in order: tool, armour, weapon, blueprint, nostats, container). viewer: the 3D item viewer's branch, pose (3x3 rotation and translation), models, each slot's texture variants, environment texture, one-sidedness, display clip and the icon generator's pose (Tools/itemicon.py viewer). tool: what a tool does in the hand: its tool types, attach node, whether it is shown, its dashboard display mode, whether it leans the torso, whether it slashes, its use sound and range (Tools/arktools.py export). wearable: a wearable's bases, nearest first, and for each shape it dresses, the sex, the models of each sex and the texture table (Tools/arkwearables.py catalogue). item_classes: each item's classes, one per client-5.4 key in key order. look_classes: each armour look's class, by VU. Not shown on the page.
